qualification.details: Junior Faculty (Design Process): Master's Degree in Fashion Design/Apparel Design / Life style Accessory Design/Knitwear Design/ Leather Design/ Textile Design with min. 55% marks. Academic and/or Industry Experience of at least 3 years in the field of Design Process. Junior Faculty (Illustration & CAD): Master's Degree in Fashion Design/Graphic Design / Communication Design/Apparel Design/Knitwear Design/ Leather Design/Textile Design/Fashion Technology /Fashion Design with min. 55% marks. Industry /Academic Experience of at least 3 years in the field of Illustration and CAD. Junior Faculty (New Product Development): Bachelors /Masters Degree (2 years after graduation) and 1 year diploma in Footwear manufacturing / Footwear Design/Footwear Production with minimum 55% Marks. Academic and/or Industry Experience of at least 3 years in the field of Footwear Design. Lab Assistant (Pattern Making & Garment Construction): Essential 12th Pass, Desirable 10th Pass. Practically sound in machine operation, Garment/Apparel pattern making, sample making and Demonstration to students.

Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.

Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 24-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for FDDI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications for the FDDI Junior Faculty and Academic Support Staff positions is 24-08-2026. Ensure your application is sent via email before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in FDDI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for the Junior Faculty and Academic Support Staff posts at FDDI Ankleshwar campus. This includes 3 positions for Junior Faculty and 1 for Lab Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Junior Faculty posts?
faq.answer: For Junior Faculty positions, candidates must possess a Master's Degree in the relevant design field with a minimum of 55% marks. Specific qualifications vary slightly depending on the specialization.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for the Lab Assistant post?
faq.answer: The essential educational qualification for the Lab Assistant post is passing the 12th grade. A desirable qualification is passing the 10th grade.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying to FDDI posts?
faq.answer: The general age limit is 35 years. Age relaxations are provided for OBC (3 years), SC/ST (5 years), and PWD (10 years) categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for Junior Faculty and Lab Assistant posts?
faq.answer: Junior Faculty will receive a salary of Rs. 50,000/- per month, while Academic Support Staff like Lab Assistants will be paid Rs. 30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply via email. The application, along with self-attested copies of relevant documents, should be sent to the specified email address before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for FDDI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Faculty and Academic Support Staff positions will be based on an Interview. Candidates shortlisted after the initial screening will be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions of Junior Faculty and Academic Support Staff at FDDI Ankleshwar are on a temporary basis.
